component.name: OpenROM
component.summary: Universal ROM Compression Suite for retro gaming

description.p: OpenROM is a free, open-source desktop tool for converting retro game ROM files between popular formats. It supports PS1, PS2, PSP, GameCube, Wii, Xbox, Dreamcast, and Sega CD disc images.

ul.li: Convert between ISO, CHD, CSO, ECM, BIN/CUE, XISO, RVZ, WIA, WBFS, GCZ
Drag and drop queue with per-job progress
Full CLI included alongside the GUI
Bundled tools — no extra installs needed
No telemetry, no network requests, runs 100% locally

description.p: Added RVZ/WIA/WBFS/GCZ support via nodtool, PSP ISO detection, and Convert button fix.
Added CLI interface, per-job progress bar, CHD info panel, and bug fixes.
